subject: Google sheets authentication in Shin apps

messages.author: c5b611e1c9abddca
messages.subject: Google sheets authentication in Shin apps
parts:
I have used google sheets for my app. and while I run it locally, it works fine as i have .httr-auth file. But when I move the data to Shiny-server folder, I could not find the httr-auth file. and as a result the tab panel where the google sheet display throws an error like "contact app author" 

I am using gs_title for getting sheets. I also used gs_url and tried, But didn't work.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Google sheets authentication in Shin apps
parts: I believe in the past that there was an issue with the IDE not including a necessary file when using the Deploy button in the interface, and that a work around to ensure that it was included was to call rsconnect::deployApp from the console.

messages.author: e5563c64d65403a1
messages.subject: Re: Google sheets authentication in Shin apps
parts:
With Flexdashboard documents / Rmarkdown docs you can specify the resource_files required within the same directory as the application file. 

Example:

---
title: "My Flexdashboard"
resource_files:
- .httr-oauth
---



You may be able to something similar with the function addResourcePath and specify the file that way.

https://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/addResourcePath.html
